name: Plan and Build
description: Structured planning and implementation process. Investigates the problem space, designs a plan, implements changes, validates with tests/lint, and commits for review. Use for any substantial feature, project, or multi-step task that benefits from upfront planning before execution.

goal.description: What to plan and build — feature, project, or multi-step task

steps.title: Investigate and gather requirements
steps.description:
Research and understand the problem space for ${goal}:
1. Check project context (project-manage read) for repo location, existing infrastructure, and prior decisions
2. Download any relevant project artifacts from Drive (listed in project context) to shared/
3. Recall memory for any prior work, decisions, or plans related to this goal
4. Investigate the current state — what exists, what's missing, what constraints apply
5. Identify stakeholders, dependencies, and technical requirements
6. Document findings as a clear situation report and write to shared/

Output: current state assessment, requirements list, constraints, and dependencies.
steps.accept_criteria: Current state is documented. Requirements are identified. Constraints and dependencies are listed. Enough context gathered to form a plan.

steps.title: Design implementation plan
steps.description:
Create a detailed plan for ${goal} based on gathered requirements:
1. Break the work into clear phases or milestones
2. For each phase, define what will be built, how it will be tested, and what 'done' looks like
3. Identify risks and mitigation strategies
4. Propose the technical approach — architecture, tools, patterns
5. Write the plan to shared/ as plan.md so it persists as a project artifact

IMPORTANT: The plan should be specific enough to execute but flexible enough to adapt. Present it to the user for approval before proceeding. Include a Drive link to the plan in your response.
steps.accept_criteria: Plan document exists with phases, approach, risks, and acceptance criteria. Plan is presented to user for review.

steps.title: Set up workspace and implement
steps.description:
Execute the approved plan for ${goal}:
1. Create a feature branch from the appropriate base branch
2. Implement changes across all identified files and modules
3. Follow existing code conventions, patterns, and style
4. Write or update tests to cover new behavior
5. Keep changes focused — avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
6. Implement incrementally — verify each logical unit compiles before moving on

Output: list of files changed, tests added, and any deviations from the plan.
steps.accept_criteria: All planned changes are implemented. Code follows existing conventions. Tests are written or updated. Changes are focused and scoped to the goal.

steps.title: Validate and commit
steps.description:
Validate and finalize the implementation of ${goal}:
1. Run the test suite — all existing and new tests must pass
2. Run linting/formatting checks and fix any violations
3. Verify the feature works end-to-end (manual smoke test if applicable)
4. Check for regressions — ensure nothing previously working is broken
5. Review changes: `git diff` to confirm only intended files are modified
6. Commit with a clear message and push to remote
7. Summarize what was built, tested, and any follow-up items
8. Artifacts in shared/ will be auto-published to the project Drive folder on completion — include Drive links in your summary

If tests fail or lint errors are found, fix them before committing.
steps.accept_criteria: All tests pass. Lint/format checks pass. No regressions. Changes committed with clear message. Summary of changes and follow-up items documented.
